run_HunyuanVideo15TextEncoderStep: run the HunyuanVideo15TextEncoderStep to encode text prompts using Qwen2.5-VL and ByT5 dual text encoders
run_HunyuanVideo15VaeEncoderStep: run the HunyuanVideo15VaeEncoderStep to encode an input image into latent space for image-to-video generation
run_HunyuanVideo15ImageEncoderStep: run the HunyuanVideo15ImageEncoderStep to produce image embeddings from a Siglip vision encoder
run_encode_prompt: run the encode_prompt method to generate prompt embeddings and masks for both positive and negative prompts
run_extract_glyph_texts: run extract_glyph_texts to extract quoted text from prompts and format them for ByT5 glyph encoding
